User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the EduVerse platform, storing their profile information and preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

preferredCurriculumIds.description: References to Curricula (e.g., CBSE, SSC) that the user has selected as their primary interest areas. (Relationship: User N:N Curriculum)

currentAcademicClassId.description: Reference to the AcademicClass (e.g., Class 10) the user is currently focused on, if applicable. (Relationship: AcademicClass 1:N User)

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Curriculum.title: Curriculum
Curriculum.description: Represents an overarching educational board or government exam body (e.g., CBSE Board, NIOS Board, SSC).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Curriculum entity.

name.description: The official name of the curriculum (e.g., 'CBSE Board', 'SSC CGL', 'NIOS Board', 'Delhi Police Exam').

description.description: A detailed description of the curriculum, including its scope and purpose.

type.description: The classification of the curriculum (e.g., 'Academic Board', 'Government Exam Body').

AcademicClass.title: AcademicClass
AcademicClass.description: Represents a specific academic grade or class within a board (e.g., Class 4, Class 12).

id.description: Unique identifier for the AcademicClass entity.

name.description: The name of the academic class (e.g., 'Class 4', 'Class 10', 'Class 12').

description.description: A brief description of the academic class and its general focus.

curriculumId.description: Reference to the Curriculum (e.g., CBSE Board, NIOS Board) this class belongs to. (Relationship: Curriculum 1:N AcademicClass)

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject (e.g., Mathematics, Science, English, General Awareness).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

name.description: The name of the subject (e.g., 'Mathematics', 'Physics', 'English Literature').

description.description: A description of the subject and its scope.

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description: Represents a specific learning topic or concept within a subject, potentially across different classes and curricula.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Topic entity.

name.description: The name of the topic (e.g., 'Quadratic Equations', 'Indian History: Mughal Empire').

description.description: A detailed description of the topic.

subjectId.description: Reference to the primary Subject this topic belongs to. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Topic)

academicClassIds.description: References to AcademicClasses where this topic is typically taught or relevant. (Relationship: AcademicClass N:N Topic)

curriculumIds.description: References to Curricula (boards/exams) where this topic is relevant. (Relationship: Curriculum N:N Topic)

LearningContent.title: LearningContent
LearningContent.description: Represents a single piece of educational material such as a video, article, quiz, or practice test.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LearningContent entity.

title.description: The title of the learning content.

description.description: A brief description or summary of what the content covers.

contentType.description: The type of content (e.g., 'Video', 'Article', 'Quiz', 'Practice Test', 'Solution Set').

url.description: The URL or file path to access the learning content, if external or downloadable.

durationMinutes.description: The estimated duration of the content in minutes (e.g., for videos, quizzes).

difficultyLevel.description: The perceived difficulty level of the content (e.g., 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

topicId.description: Reference to the primary Topic that this content covers. (Relationship: Topic 1:N LearningContent)

relatedTopicIds.description: References to other Topics that are also relevant or covered by this content. (Relationship: Topic N:N LearningContent)

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the learning content was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the learning content was last updated.

Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: Represents an official external examination, such as a government competitive exam or a board final exam.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Exam entity.

name.description: The official name of the exam (e.g., 'SSC CGL Tier I 2023', 'CBSE Class 10 Math Final Exam').

description.description: A description of the exam, including its format and syllabus.

examDate.description: The official date of the exam, if known.

curriculumId.description: Reference to the Curriculum (e.g., SSC, CBSE Board) this exam falls under. (Relationship: Curriculum 1:N Exam)

totalMarks.description: The maximum marks obtainable in the exam.

durationMinutes.description: The official duration of the exam in minutes.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a single question used in quizzes, practice tests, or mock exams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

text.description: The full text of the question.

questionType.description: The format of the question (e.g., 'Multiple Choice', 'True/False', 'Fill in the Blanks', 'Short Answer').

options.description: An array of possible answer options for multiple-choice questions.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer to the question. For multiple choice, this would be the text of the correct option or its index.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation or solution for the correct answer.

difficultyLevel.description: The perceived difficulty level of the question (e.g., 'Easy', 'Medium', 'Hard').

topicId.description: Reference to the Topic this question is primarily related to. (Relationship: Topic 1:N Question)

UserLearningActivity.title: UserLearningActivity
UserLearningActivity.description: Tracks a user's progress and interaction with specific learning content items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserLearningActivity entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the activity. (Relationship: User 1:N UserLearningActivity)

learningContentId.description: Reference to the LearningContent that was interacted with. (Relationship: LearningContent 1:N UserLearningActivity)

status.description: The current status of the user's interaction with the content (e.g., 'Started', 'Completed', 'Passed', 'Failed', 'Reviewed').

score.description: The score obtained by the user for this content, if applicable (e.g., for quizzes or practice tests).

timeSpentSeconds.description: The total time spent by the user on this content in seconds.

lastAccessedAt.description: The timestamp of the last access to this learning content by the user.

completedAt.description: The timestamp when the user completed the learning content, if applicable.

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Tracks a user's specific attempt at an official Exam, including their performance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExamAttempt entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who made the exam attempt. (Relationship: User 1:N ExamAttempt)

examId.description: Reference to the Exam that was attempted. (Relationship: Exam 1:N ExamAttempt)

startTime.description: The timestamp when the user started the exam attempt.

endTime.description: The timestamp when the user completed or submitted the exam attempt.

score.description: The final score obtained by the user in this exam attempt.

status.description: The status of the exam attempt (e.g., 'Completed', 'Abandoned', 'Graded').

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Represents an AI-generated or user-created personalized study plan for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlan entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User for whom this study plan was created. (Relationship: User 1:N StudyPlan)

name.description: A descriptive name for the study plan (e.g., 'My CBSE Class 10 Math Plan', 'SSC CGL Prep Plan').

description.description: A detailed description of the study plan's focus, objectives, and scope.

startDate.description: The planned start date for the study plan.

endDate.description: The planned end date for the study plan.

goals.description: A list of specific learning goals for this study plan (e.g., 'Complete Algebra module', 'Achieve 80% in Mock Exam 1').

status.description: The current status of the study plan (e.g., 'Active', 'Completed', 'Archived', 'Draft').

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the study plan was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the study plan was last updated.

StudyPlanItem.title: StudyPlanItem
StudyPlanItem.description: Represents an individual task or learning content item that is part of a StudyPlan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPlanItem entity.

studyPlanId.description: Reference to the StudyPlan this item belongs to. (Relationship: StudyPlan 1:N StudyPlanItem)

learningContentId.description: Reference to the LearningContent to be studied or completed as part of this item. (Relationship: LearningContent 1:N StudyPlanItem)

dueDate.description: The target date by which this item should ideally be completed.

status.description: The completion status of the study plan item (e.g., 'Pending', 'Completed', 'Overdue', 'Skipped').

notes.description: Any additional notes or specific instructions for completing this study plan item.

orderIndex.description: The sequential order or priority of this item within its study plan.

definition.description: Dedicated collection for administrative roles. The mere existence of a document at this path for a given 'userId' grants administrative privileges. This provides a clear and independent DBAC mechanism, avoiding custom claims and 'get()' operations for authorization. Only administrators can read/write.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of a user who holds an administrative role.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for EduVerse prioritizes **Authorization Independence** and **Structural Segregation** to ensure robust, scalable, and debuggable security rules. Publicly accessible educational resources are stored in top-level collections, while all user-specific data is nested under dedicated `/users/{userId}` subcollections.

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization (Mandate A):**

1.  **Public Collections (e.g., `/curricula`, `/topics`):** These collections contain global data that is universally readable by all authenticated users. No authorization context from parent documents is required for these, as they are independent entities. Write access to these collections will be restricted to administrative roles, which are managed via a separate, independent `roles_admin` collection, avoiding `get()` calls for authorization checks.
2.  **User-Owned Data (e.g., `/users/{userId}/studyPlans`):** For all user-specific data (like `UserLearningActivity`, `ExamAttempt`, `StudyPlan`, and `StudyPlanItem`), the `userId` is explicitly embedded in the Firestore path. This design ensures that security rules can directly compare `request.auth.uid` with the `{userId}` wildcard in the path (e.g., `match /users/{userId}/studyPlans/{studyPlanId} { allow read, write: if request.auth.uid == userId; }`). This completely eliminates the need for `get()` calls to a parent document (e.g., the `User` document or `StudyPlan` document) to determine ownership, thereby achieving atomic and independent authorization for every document in these subcollections. The `userId` (and `studyPlanId` for `studyPlanItems`) fields within the documents serve as data integrity checks but are not used for authorization decision-making, as the path itself carries the necessary authorization context.

**Structural Segregation for QAPs (Mandate B & C):**

1.  **Homogeneous Security Posture:** Collections like `/curricula`, `/academicClasses`, `/subjects`, `/topics`, `/learningContent`, `/exams`, and `/questions` are designed for global read access by all authenticated users. Their security posture is uniform, meaning all documents within these collections share the same access requirements. This inherently supports **Query Ability Predictability (QAPs)** because `list` operations on these collections will return all accessible data without requiring server-side filtering by security rules.
2.  **Path-Based Ownership for User Data:** User-specific subcollections like `/users/{userId}/learningActivities`, `/users/{userId}/examAttempts`, and `/users/{userId}/studyPlans` are strictly owned by the `userId` specified in their path. A user can only perform `list` operations within their own `/users/{userId}/...` scope. This structural segregation guarantees that `list` queries are inherently secure and efficient, returning only data authorized for the requesting user based on their UID in the path, fulfilling QAPs.
3.  **DBAC for Global Roles:** An explicit `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection is used to define global administrative roles. The existence of a document at `/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid)` grants administrative privileges, allowing for DBAC without custom claims and ensuring authorization independence for administrative write operations on public data.

This structure provides a clear, predictable, and maintainable foundation for security rules, directly addressing the core design principles and mandates.
